title: MATLAB code for 'Microglia deliver the seeds and diffusion delivers the mass: a transport model of amyloid-β propagation into naive brain tissue'

creators.name: Kuznetsov, Andrey V
creators.affiliation: Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, North Carolina State University, Raleigh, NC 27695-7910, USA

description:
MATLAB implementation of a transport model of amyloid-β (Aβ) propagation into naive brain tissue, in which microglia deliver aggregation-competent seeds and diffusion supplies almost all of the mass that follows.

Six fields are solved on a spherically symmetric domain by a conservative finite-volume method: free diffusible Aβ, deposited fibrillar Aβ, microglia-internalised cargo, microglial density, an injury-derived chemoattractant, and the number density of distinguishable deposits. Deposit number is carried as a separate field so that the model can be compared with the two-dimensional histological area fraction actually measured, rather than with deposit mass.

The package contains the solver and its model routines, the calibration of six constants to six published targets, the diagnostics, a single script that writes all figures of the paper and its supplementary material, the stored calibration and figure outputs, and a README documenting every file. Experimental values are taken from the Source Data files of d'Errico et al. (2022, Nat Neurosci 25, 20-25), not digitised from printed figures.

Base MATLAB only, no toolboxes; developed and run on R2023a.
